content: Onboarding took forever — I couldn't figure out how to invite my team. The invitation links are failing on Firefox browser.
The app is super snappy today! Noticeable improvement in database queries and dashboard loads.
It does the job, but the mobile experience needs work. Tables shrink and horizontal scroll is a nightmare on smaller screens.
Why does the billing invoice PDF keep failing to download? I've been trying to submit expenses for 3 days.
Okta integration was seamless! Our compliance team is happy with the SAML security validation.
The pricing structure is not transparent. We got billed for 15 deactivated seats without notifications.
Android application crashes immediately when I open the analytics charts tab. Working on v2.1.0, crashed on v2.1.1.
We are considering upgrading to the Enterprise tier, but we require a signed SLA and custom yearly invoice processing.
Absolutely loving the clean UI redesign! Navigation is much faster and simpler. Good job on the update.
SSO logins keep dropping every time I close my Chrome window. This is forcing daily authentications.
The tutorial guides are too long. Let us skip the walkthrough and go straight to the project dashboard.
Billing page throws a 500 error when attempting to update credit card details. This is blocking our renewal.
Great desktop experience, but the mobile layout has cut-off headers. Hard to tap navigation buttons on iPhone SE.
Is there a plan to support webhooks for notifications? We need real-time alerts in Slack when tickets fail.
Security logs do not show IP addresses. This is a critical auditing failure for our company compliance.
Excellent documentation. It took our engineering team less than an hour to set up the workspace.
NPS question is popping up too frequently. Please change the trigger interval to 90 days.
Support agent was very helpful but the app itself is too slow when loading historical search tables.
I received a duplicate charge this month. Please refund the secondary transaction.
The team page has a pagination bug where clicking page 2 just refreshes the current active page.
